title: Is it as bad as non-AI communities telling me?
author: LowSuccessful
selftext:
Hi people,

I am making that game for 3 weeks and I think I will need two more before the demo.  
The Idea is mixing dispatch and gacha, with some kingdom management. So far it plays pretty fun, even half-balanced. But here is the thing:  
\- Tiles are from the asset I bought in [itch.io](http://itch.io)  
\- Since the game is gacha - I had to generate anime-like characters. They are AI.  
\- Since I use AI and don't plan to hide it - I leaned to a little bit AI-sloppish title and its style. I saw a lot of that on web novel sites and it seems to work really well there. So I also decided that it will be a good idea to use isekai-like title. My wife loves the concept and my pretty sceptical friend actually said "Wow", when I showed it to him.

So when I posted to SoloDevelopmend cimmunity, I expected to receive some criticism but it appeared to be just devastating.  
"3 styles on one picture", "Dumb king", "Heroes from romantic visual novel", "What's with the title?"  
I work with AI for a lot of time and tried to give the heroes a unique style that is not straightforwardly AI-sloppish. I can't believe I failed that much.

So... you probably not-so-against AI. Please tell me, are they right? Should I move completely to another direction here? Or only stats from real Steam gamers matters?

replies.author: zmizzy
replies.body: worse imo

comments.author: Captain_Slib
comments.body: "Leaning into the slop style" makes it look extremely low effort. And yes, the arts types clash. Unfortunately, this is pretty painful to look at. I love dispatch stuff, but I wouldnt give this a second glance.

comments.author: SimoneNonvelodico
comments.body: Yeah this looks like Generic AI Game No.95673. The isekai/progression fantasy style title doesn't help, though I can see the concept being funny especially if executed in a satirical way.

replies.author: LowSuccessful
replies.body:
Well, I won't be making a parody or something like that, but I really couldn't go completely without a satire, so I started making some of the characters based on memes and famous paintings. I can't repeat them exactly for legal reasons, but I think they are still recognizable and unique at the end. I will probably make all like that  
(for example, the guy at the left named Abe - his ability, "Summer Festival", provides 20% discounts on gacha banners for 10 turns)

https://i.redd.it/3ui1vuhj8nyh1.png

replies.author: itix
replies.body: Looks like a new incarnation of Microsoft Office Clip Art.

comments.author: Suecotero
comments.body:
It's not the sloppiest thing I've ever seen but I can still tell it's generative art.

That's not necessarily a dealbreaker in my book if the game is well-put together, but the gold standard for AI art is one that has been prompted and modified enough that it's not recognizable as AI art anymore.

comments.author: jshmoe866
comments.body:
This looks like every other kingdom game that’s come out in the past. 

The art can be changed what matters is the gameplay which we haven’t seen

comments.author: LowSuccessful
comments.body:
thanks people.

I still can't believe that I am being downvoted in aigamedev community,

but I will try my best to please you in the future

replies.author: zenmatrix83
replies.body: if you read anything ai in reddit you get shown anything ai, which alot of anti people see this, and for awhile I saw the anti ai subs till I mouted them

replies.author: Huge_Information5083
replies.body: I think even if everyone is okay with AI, people are not okay with the art style being so different between the characters, and it's also very recognizable as AI art style.

replies.author: ObservableObject
replies.body:
Why can't you believe it?

People who hate AI will hate something made with AI, even if it is objectively high quality... but people who like/are OK with AI aren't going to like your project just because it's made with AI or something.

If it's not good, it's not good.

replies.author: LowSuccessful
replies.body:
Because there are posts like that. It is a very straightforward AI generation with a lot of unnecessary details - I got picture like that when prompting my map at the first day. (and then decided to seek for an asset from a real artist)

which means there is no art direction at all - it is just generated and shipped. Still, people like that... ok...

https://i.redd.it/2dcmbqzjanyh1.png

comments.author: Huge_Information5083
comments.body:
4/5 characters are rendered in different art styles and it's extremely obvious to me, as a non-artist. 

I think you need to consume more media - play more video games, watch more animations, go on artstation and see people's art.

replies.author: LowSuccessful
replies.body:
I am consuming media for 15 years. The question is what I can actually do and how to do it.  
For example, the girl is from the picture The Unknown Woman by Ivan Kramskoi  
The prince at the middle based on Borat.  
Other characters are still generic but they fit to composition. I actually have 20 more that based on famous paintings or memes. So I will probably remake all to that

replies.author: Huge_Information5083
replies.body: The male characters looks like studio ghibli style with semi realism rendering, the elf girl is just classic pixiv anime art style. Your best bet is the style of the girl on the top left.

replies.author: LowSuccessful
replies.body: thanks, that's useful!

comments.author: zenmatrix83
comments.body: I don't like some of the charcters  expeciall ythe guy in the upper right hand side, it seems very similar to others, I'd rather see unique characters. The rest seems fine, but try hard to be as unique as possible where you can

replies.author: LowSuccessful
replies.body: noted, thanks. I actually started using famous paintings and memes and reference, but here only 2 of 5 are from that batch. I think I will make all to that

comments.author: fhtiek
comments.body:
Yeah it really has the hallmarks everywhere. I dont think the "Im leaning into the style on purpose" is going to change perception either.

Even if the game is actually great under the hood I can tell you with certainty based on the presentation this would be an instant skip for me. "Leaning into the slop look" and actually being slop are functionally the same thing for a first impression made on a pitential player. 

Simply, games are a deeply crowded market and consumers I think primarily make their choices based on maximizing fun in their finite available time to play.   This capsule tells me "super low effort, definitely not worth it". The game underneath could be great but very few will ever see it at all since the first impression is a turn off

comments.author: JonNewEra
comments.body: yea its pretty bad, sorry. but keep trying!

comments.author: TeeRKee
comments.body: yes, there is like nort consistency or direction

comments.author: Stinky_You
comments.body: I mean bro. 3 weeks is enough to start to learn the process if you're smart, but there are ACTUAL professional devs (not me) that are here, know the process, and are solo. They're not putting anything of quality out in three weeks. AI will do whatever you tell it to. Ask it for advice since it knows more than the likes of you and I

replies.author: LowSuccessful
replies.body: Well, AI actually made this when I asked him to generate characters using the map tiles style (which are painted by a real artist) - so Claude thinks that it is already peak, unless i give him info from that comments section. which will definitely help

replies.author: Stinky_You
replies.body: I use Claude too. I ask it a lot of questions about the process and had it make rules to help explain and stick to the process (I get distracted and had to restart 3 times) so things don't get messy. Rules to do things one at a time and have an agreed plan before anything is built or added to the plan so things won't conflict easily in the future. Idk man, it's a tool for whatever you want basically, I'm using it to learn so I don't assemble a complete pile of dooky. Claude isn't really a great judge of what everybody thinks is peak, obviously

replies.author: LowSuccessful
replies.body: I would give him rules if I knew. But I personally like these characters and didn't see the issue. So after today, I am going to experiment more. I am quite the power user but my imagination and artistic capabilities turned out to be limited :(

comments.author: PhantomZenithOrigin
comments.body: This looks gorgeous, though it's a bit over-detailed for a capsule, the characters too small.  Your characters look great, though they don't match.  There are four distinct styles demonstrated here and they're all different art directions.

replies.author: LowSuccessful
replies.body: thanks for a comforting way to give criticism, I appreciate that. I will remake them, definitely

comments.author: MrBrightside711
comments.body: Your characters don't look like they belong in the same universe

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body: Well, it's pretty ai. Depends on the game if it's bad. But I would bet my house that the game doesn't look this good or animations suck ass

replies.author: LowSuccessful
replies.body:
oh thats my thing, actually. I always put graphics from the game on the capsule. So the game will look exactly like this.   
Also meaning that changing that capsule means redrawing all the characters inside the game. But I am willing to do that.

replies.author: Livid_Shallot5701
replies.body: Are they animated like perfectly? Or are they static pictures you "Polish"? I have never seen ai animations on the level of your pictures being made since that would be ginormous effort

replies.author: LowSuccessful
replies.body:
well, they will be static, actually. Like character cards.  
but for their skills I wil lbe making short animagions... with AI. And video models usually provide even more AI sloppish picture.

But thats ok. The whole Early Access version will take maximum 2 months and 300 dollars. So I will do the best I can and see how the game is actually received. I personally believe in the idea very much. Its just amazing. Not Civ 6 or Dispatch, but I think better than Humanity or This is the Police

comments.author: cheyumaama
comments.body: From the picture alone, it looks fine to me. Why do you care what they think? Do YOU enjoy playing it?

replies.author: LowSuccessful
replies.body:
yes, I enjoy it very much. Thanks for asking!

I think I managed to create the game when you always want to perform "One more turn". And I can't wait to share it with people. I think it is great. Not the greatest, but great enough.  
And this is not my dream game, or passion project, I just came up with it and thought it would be great. And still can't believe how good it is becoming.

But the first impression people will get is from the capsule. It will be seen by very broad audience, that's why it is a good idea to ask that the broad audience if it is really intriguing or not...

replies.author: cheyumaama
replies.body: I don't know if the people commenting are just soulless NPCs or if they have some sort of mass psychosis going on, but there's no link to your game on the post and for them to just judge the entire game off of one picture is just giving demonic tribal animal energy

replies.author: LowSuccessful
replies.body:
thanks. I knew that they will be angry because "AI", "game in 3 weeks", but didn't expected such thermonuclear reaction.  
Well, nevertheless, if people think like that - then changes have to be made. It will only make my game better. So no matter the downvotes, I win anyway

comments.author: SoMuchMango
comments.body:
You just wrote that you are targeting low quality vibe. :D 

  
Hiding AI style it is not something people plan. Hiding AI style it is something where effort should be mostly put when doing anything with AI.

comments.author: d1knight
comments.body:
I'm pro AI and developing games with AI including arts. 

Their comment is fair and accurate. It could be great game inside but this capsule art is AI slop by definition. If you cannot see it you really need to develop your taste.
